reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Normal-prior NB estimator with simulations, held-out RNA and optional orthogonal validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution plan to consult and verify primary Methods, supplements or validated tool protocols and transfer their settings to the selected dataset. Documenting settings or calling a method standard is not that action.
The NB coefficient is on the natural-log scale in log(mu), but the strong-effect threshold is log2(1.5) or log2(2) without conversion. This changes the biological threshold.

checks.quote: by empirical Bayes or hierarchical Bayes
checks.reason: The alternatives are named but no selected estimator, normalization, solver/convergence or concrete calibration-to-setting procedure is supplied.

checks.quote: difference in mean normalized counts or a rank-based statistic
checks.reason: These validation quantities cannot be compared in magnitude or plotted on an identity line against training log fold changes. A matched log-ratio estimand and uncertainty are required. Unvalidated genes are also not automatically false positives.
Biological replication is recognized, but a justified meaningful-effect/precision or power calculation and simulation Monte Carlo precision/stopping rule are absent.
No operational randomized/balanced processing or masked QC/estimator-comparison plan, nor justified equivalent bias control, is specified.
Eligibility intent is present but failed-fit/missing-measurement handling, all-eligible denominators and stopping/maximal acquisition rules remain unspecified.
No executable primary method-difference uncertainty procedure and relevant multiplicity/error-control rule is fixed; listing metrics or interval outputs is insufficient.
Sensitivity scenarios are named, but bounded settings or a concrete derivation-and-lock procedure for the essential prior/filter/model choices are absent.
Possible failure modes are named without a diagnostic result linked to an ordered technical repair and retest.
No operational iteration policy identifies what stays frozen, what may change and the fresh independent confirmation required after a change.

The validation success condition requires low-information extremes rarely replicate regardless of whether they are real. Real low-count biology can replicate; the rejection gate must use known-null/error evidence, not reward lack of replication as a universal success.

The plan acknowledges counts-only limits, but does not specify an immutable executable environment, full commands, unit-to-library/output mapping and figure-source audit. The conditional raw-read list alone is insufficient.
Unrestricted label permutation can invalidate a paired or batch-adjusted design; exchangeability blocks are not defined. Missing-data rules and composition/outlier stress are also absent.
Figure concepts do not supply numeric source tables plus a clean-environment rerun, numerical tolerances, resource/failure logs and source-difference audit.
